text:
Maya: Heads-up — change window starts in ~50m. We need canaries pinned and rollback playbook ready.
Sam: Got it. Canaries: inference-api v2026-03-20-rc1 (2 pods in us-west1). Rolling to 4 if green.
Deploy Bot: deploy started for inference-api:v2026-03-20-rc1 — canary shards 2/2
Maya: Quick readiness checklist:
 - [ ] Perf smoke on staging
 - [ ] A/B flags in place
 - [ ] Metrics dashboards -> alert thresholds
 - [ ] Rollback tag set
Sam: perf smoke done (latency +/-5%), sending updated hash: a1b2c3
Jordan: I pushed rollback image tag rollback-1900 to registry and documented steps in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rollback-inference
Alina: Confirming DB migrations: none. KV cache schema unchanged. :thumbsup:
Maya: Ops, can we ensure throttling policy is enabled for /generate route? config:
```
route: /v1/generate
rate_limit: 200rps
burst: 400
pin_model: redwood/llm-7b-qat:v1
```
Ops Runner: throttling enabled in nginx-prod. I'll keep an eye on 429s.
Sam: If canary sees >3% error or +30% p95 latency, immediate rollback.
Maya: Agree. Also keep deploy-bot auto-fallback ON — if only partial failures, fallback to redwood/llm-7b-quant:v0.9
Deploy Bot: Canary success after 12m. Metrics stable. Proceeding to rollout to 30%.
Maya: Proceed with rollout. Sam standby for rollback window.
Jordan: Noted — documented incident channel #incidents/launch-v2 and escalation page.
Alina: Final: Release notes pushed to docs, customer-facing note scheduled for 10:15 PDT.
Maya: Copy. Post-launch, we do 30m quiet window then trend check at 1h and 4h. :coffee:
Sam: All set. I'll monitor traces. Ping me if anything.
Maya: Thanks everyone. I'll close when 4h checks are done.
